title: Разговор через вентиляцию  (Talking Through the Ventilation Shaft)

segments.t: To reach Elena's locked room above the kitchen, Chef Barinov climbs into the ventilation shaft and gets stuck. Admitting to Max that it is time to take responsibility for his actions, Viktor inspires Max to speak to Vika through the vent and promise to stand by her and their daughter.
Я с ней ещё пока не поговорил.
Теперь пришло время отвечать за поступки.
Вик, делай что хочешь, я всё равно буду рядом.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Vika, forgive me once again.' The meaning hinges on 'Vika' working together with 'forgive' in spoken Russian.
'Are you still here?' The grammar packs 'you' and 'here' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Я с ней ещё пока не поговорил.
'I have not talked to her yet.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'I', while 'to have a talk' completes the thought. Vika answers right away.
'I am warning you: step back!' Vika brings out the contrast between 'warn' and 'step aside' in a few short words.
'Chef, why did you not turn back?' The meaning hinges on 'Chef Barinov' working together with 'returned' in spoken Russian.
'I always used to do that.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'did'.
Теперь пришло время отвечать за поступки.
'Now the time has come to answer for my actions.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'now', while 'actions' completes the thought.
'Before you and our daughter!' The grammar packs 'before' and 'daughter' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Вик, делай что хочешь, я всё равно буду рядом.
'Vika, do whatever you want, I will still be right beside you.' The meaning hinges on 'Vika' working together with 'beside' in spoken Russian.
'Because I love you both.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'that is why' before landing on 'like'.
'There is a chance that everything will work out!' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'there is', while 'to work out' completes the thought.

'Hang on, chef, we will pull you out right now!' The grammar packs 'stick' and 'to pull out' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Я с ней ещё пока не поговорил.
Теперь пришло время отвечать за поступки.
Вик, делай что хочешь, я всё равно буду рядом.
And that finishes the heartfelt scene in the ventilation shaft. Listen for the phrase meaning the time has come to answer for one's actions and Max's promise to Vika. See you in the next scene.
